geo_basis: city named in the headline (Karachi); city centre coordinates
plain: Pakistan's cybercrime agency says it caught an alleged gang of three friends in Karachi who defrauded elderly people with false health remedies, and recovered Rs 15 crore in cash.
summary: Pakistan's National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) uncovered a cyber fraud network in Karachi, Jang reports. According to NCCIA Additional Director Shahzad Akbar, an alleged gang of three friends targeted elderly people with false health remedies. Rs 15 crore in cash was recovered, total recovery reached Rs 25 crore, and evidence of Rs 1 arab 20 crore was found in the suspects' accounts.
title: Pakistan's NCCIA says it uncovered a Karachi cyber fraud gang targeting the elderly, recovering Rs 15 crore in cash

validation.note: Single publisher (Jang) relaying NCCIA Additional Director Shahzad Akbar; no second publisher found.
